I have created [filter.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-m858ryfi/filter.py) (mounted at `/app/filter.py` inside the container) to sanitize HTML files in-place and strip JavaScript/XSS vectors while preserving legitimate HTML structure and formatting.

### Summary of Implementation
- **Command-Line Interface**: [`main`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-m858ryfi/filter.py#L373-L384) reads the target HTML file from `sys.argv[1]` and writes the sanitized output back in-place.
- **Formatting & Structure Preservation**: [`_AllWhitespaceSet`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-m858ryfi/filter.py#L25-L29) and [`_PreserveOrderHTMLFormatter`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-m858ryfi/filter.py#L32-L45) configure BeautifulSoup's `HTMLParserTreeBuilder` to retain original whitespace, indentation, attribute ordering, void element syntax, and safe HTML entities.
- **XSS & JavaScript Removal**: [`sanitize_html`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-m858ryfi/filter.py#L201-L370) performs a multi-pass sanitization that:
  - Decomposes active/executable tags (`<script>`, `<iframe>`, `<object>`, `<embed>`, `<applet>`, `<base>`, SVG `<set>`/`<animate>`/`<foreignObject>`/`<use>`, dangerous `<meta>`/`<link>`/`<style>` blocks, and malformed tag names).
  - Unwraps `<noscript>`, `<template>`, `<noembed>`, and `<noframes>` tags so hidden payloads are parsed and stripped.
  - Removes all inline event handlers (`on*`) and dangerous attributes (`srcdoc`, `autofocus`, etc.).
  - Decodes HTML character references, URL encoding, and control/whitespace characters via [`is_dangerous_url`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-m858ryfi/filter.py#L144-L176) and [`is_dangerous_style`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-m858ryfi/filter.py#L179-L198) to strip `javascript:`, `vbscript:`, `data:` (non-image), and CSS `expression()`/`url(javascript:...)` vectors.
